content.title: Oscars 2026 Winners: See the Complete List
content.text: Skip to main content Oscars 2026 Winners: See the Complete List The full rundown of who won what on film’s biggest night Michael B. Jordan accepts the Best Actor in a Leading Role award for ‘Sinners’ during the 98th Oscars. Kevin Winter/Getty Images The most anticipated night in Hollywood has finally arrived! On Sunday, the biggest names in the film industry gathered for the 98th Academy Awards, officially closing out the 2026 awards season. Sinners will be the film to watch, as it has already made history with a record-breaking 16 nominations. But One Battle After Another is close on its heels with 13. Ryan Coogler’s blues-inspired vampire flick and Paul Thomas Anderson’s family drama/political thriller will compete for Best Picture, while both filmmakers are up for Best Director. In Best Picture, Sinners and One Battle are up against Bugonia, F1, Frankenstein, Hamnet, Marty Supreme, The Secret Agent, Sentimental Value, and Train Dreams. Along with Best Picture and Director, Sinners star Michael B. Jordan was nominated for Best Actor, while Delroy Lindo and Wunmi Mosaku received recognition for their supporting performances. The film also earned nominations for Best Original Screenplay, Best Original Song (for “I Lied to You”), Best Original Score, and a host of production and technical categories. As for One Battle After Another, its stars Leonardo DiCaprio, Benicio Del Toro, Sean Penn, and Teyana Taylor all scored acting nominations. Anderson also picked up a Best Adapted Screenplay nomination (the film is inspired by Thomas Pynchon’s novel Vineland), while Radiohead’s Jonny Greenwood — a frequent Anderson collaborator — earned a nod for his original score. Meanwhile, three films picked up nine nominations each: Josh Safdie’s Marty Supreme, Guillermo del Toro’s Frankenstein, and Joachim Trier’s Sentimental Value. Timothée Chalamet secured his second Best Actor nod in a row for his performance in Safdie’s edge-of-your-seat ping-pong flick, with the star competing against Jordan, DiCaprio, Ethan Hawke for Blue Moon, and Wagner Moura for The Secret Agent. And if the Golden Globes and Actor Awards are any indication for tonight, it’ll come down to Chalamet and Jordan for the award. Editor’s picks Another crowd favorite, Hamnet, picked up eight nominations. The 98th Oscars will also see the introduction of a new prize, Best Casting, which is the first new category to be added to the Academy Awards in more than 20 years. The inaugural nominees for the prize are Hamnet, Marty Supreme, One Battle After Another, The Secret Agent, and Sinners. Conan O’Brien is returning as host after earning rave reviews for his work helming the show in 2025. Check below for the full list of winners (in bold).
